description: Find local businesses in the Georgian Bay and Simcoe County area of Ontario that do a kind of work. Pass the trade or category in plain words ("roofer", "plumber", "hair salon", "dentist"), not a whole sentence; the list_coverage tool returns the category names ShoreGrade uses. Each result links its ShoreGrade page and carries a website score. A ShoreGrade score measures a business's website and Google listing out of 100. It does not rate the quality of the work, the service or the reliability of the business.

town.description: One of the towns ShoreGrade covers. Leave it out to search the whole area.

what.description: The kind of work or business, or a business name.

name: find_local_business
title: Find a local business
